scientific_claim: Frozen released pi0.5 attachment adaptation on tasks/goals held out from source-teacher and meta-training; VLA pretraining novelty and unseen scene/primitive transfer are not claimed.
family_rule: Connected components under equal normalized full BDDL goal with referenced object bindings OR identical normalized full public instruction, across scenes; all connected siblings share partition.
validation_selection: Seed-0 shuffle of sorted family IDs, first reachable whole-family subset of exactly ten tasks via deterministic dynamic programming; all other eligible LIBERO90 tasks train.

restrictions.deployment_online_dsrl_comparator: Separate evaluation-only clone with its own K-attempt feedback/updates, charged interactions, and no exports to teacher/meta-training/selection data.
restrictions.split_unit: whole task family, then whole multi-episode trial; sampled windows inherit parent-trial split
restrictions.shared_motor_feature_space: one released pi0.5 checkpoint/receipt and one fixed common feature contract; no per-task changing feature coordinates

future_ood.status: locked future final tests; task/variant identities not selected using results
future_ood.lineage: Every variant must record originating canonical LIBERO task and variant kind; all descendants inherit their base family partition. Variants of meta-training tasks assess perturbation robustness, not unseen base-task transfer.
future_ood.tuning: No final Plus/Pro feedback may select teachers, curriculum, features, checkpoints or hyperparameters; any development variants must be separately declared before testing.

audit.shared_scene_is_permitted: Task/goal-composition transfer is tested; unseen physical scenes or primitive goals are not claimed.
